units.en: ⟦0⟧ unlocks technologies related to computing, radios, radar, fortifications, nuclear weapons, rockets, and rocket engines. Like ⟦1⟧, engineering technologies tend to provide general bonuses on the country level, but unlike industry technologies, these bonuses tend to be ones related to research speed or unit stats, not economic benefits (at least, not directly). Without ⟦2⟧, it also includes technologies that affect encryption and decryption.

These technologies are heavily interlinked with special projects, with many of them either requiring or unlocking certain projects. Some engineering technologies are also tied to specific special project categories, providing breakthrough progress in them when being researched and benefitting from any ⟦0⟧ engaged in passive research in the field. Notably, technologies with a red ribbon in the bottom right-hand corner of their icons are tied to aerodynamics and avionics projects, those with a yellow ribbon in the bottom right-hand corner of their icons are tied to nuclear research projects, and those with both red and yellow ribbons (e.g. radar technologies) are tied to both special project categories.
This tree improves research speeds, radar technology, and radio technology and unlocks. Electronic engineering is also sometimes referred to as ⟦0⟧.

Electronic mechanical engineeringWe live in an age when electrical machines can no longer only warm and light us, but help us think and communicate. Electronics will be key to military intelligence in the coming century.
Upgrades Research speed: +3% Enables Central Rangefinding ship module Unlocks Radar
RadioAdopting the inventions of amateur radio operators and extending the use of FM radio will reduce radio interference and allow us to find new uses for radio technology.
Upgrades Reinforce rate: +2% Coordination: +2% Enables Basic Radio tank module Radio Navigation I airplane module Basic radio land cruiser module
Improved RadioImprovements in signal strength has allowed Radios to be broadcasted further than ever before.
Upgrades Reinforce rate: +2% Coordination: +2% Enables Improved Radio tank module Radio Navigation II airplane module Improved radio land cruiser module Unlocks Proximity Fuze
Advanced RadioAdvancements in Radio technology has increased the range of radios, and even made some of them small enough to be carried. Some call it the Walkie-Talkie
Upgrades Reinforce rate: +1% Coordination: +2% Enables Advanced Radio tank module Advanced radio land cruiser module
Cavity MagnatronUsing a tube that generates microwaves called a Cavity Magnatron we can dramatically improve existing radar systems ability to detect objects by bouncing waves off of them.
Upgrades Coordination: +1% Increases radar station limit to 2 per state Enables Improved Decimetric Naval Search Radar ship module
Centimetric RadarNew radar operating in the microwave bands enable us to detect objects too small for previous radars to pick up.
Upgrades Coordination: +2% Static anti air hit chance factor: +20% Increases radar station limit to 4 per state Enables Air-Air Radar I airplane module Air-Ground Radar I airplane module
Static anti air hit chance factor: ⟦0⟧

Phased ArrayUnlike traditional radar that relies on mechanical rotation phased arrays use electronics to steer the beam, allowing it to perform multiple functions simultaneously, such as tracking multiple targets.
Upgrades Coordination: +1% Static anti air hit chance factor: +20% Increases radar station limit to 5 per state Enables Air-Air Radar II airplane module Centimetric Gunnery Radar ship module
Monopulse RadarWith monopulse radar we can determine the direction of a target by comparing signals from sevel antennas, improving detection.
Upgrades Coordination: +1% Static anti air hit chance factor: +20% Increases radar station limit to 6 per state Enables Air-Ground Radar II airplane module Integrated Fire Control Radar ship module
Mechanical ComputingConstructing machines capable of advanced differential analysis will radically change what sort of machine-assisted calculations can be made.
Upgrades Research speed: +4% Enables Bomb Sights I airplane module Unlocks Machine-Assisted Decryption intelligence agency upgrade Machine-Assisted Encryption intelligence agency upgrade

Computing MachineDeveloping a theoretical groundwork for modern computers and constructing electromechanical machines to start putting them into practice will be the first steps into this realm of possibilities.

Improved Computing MachineElectronic digital computers can now be made which are programmable. Although still expensive and large, these machines allow for intelligence analysis far beyond human capacity.
Upgrades Research speed: +8% Enables Stabilizer tank module Bomb Sights II airplane module

Advanced Computing MachineBeginning to work on computers capable of storing programs and making use of transistors will put us on the path to a Digital Revolution where these machines may be used in nearly any field.
Basic Fire Control SystemAll fire of the ship's guns is controlled from a central position, ensuring a tighter grouping of shots and increases accuracy.
Improved Fire Control SystemBy entering course, speed and distance of a target, a mechanical computer can accurately predict where the target will be when the next salvo is ready to fire.
Advanced Fire Control SystemBy entering course, speed and distance of a target, a mechanical computer can accurately predict where the target will be when the next salvo is ready to fire.
Encryption - Polyalphabetical CiphersWith new methods of communication comes new risks for interception. Rotor cipher machines can be used to allow for rapid, complex encryption.

Encryption - Cyclic PermutationsLimitation in the randomization of cipher machines can be exploited to break the ciphers. By improving the randomness of the rotor mechanics, we can make this kind of cryptanalysis more difficult.
Encryption - Pulse-code ModulationTechnological improvements and hard-earned experience allows us to implement more traffic flow security measures in our communication.
Decryption - Frequency AnalysisCryptanalysis is increasingly becoming an advanced mathematical science. Systems like card catalogs and devices like cyclometers can aid the necessary work.

Decryption - Side-channel AttackThe development of more sophisticated computers allows for new applications of cryptanalysis methods like differencing, which can be used to break advanced cyphers when combined with new hand codebreaking methods.

Decryption - Automated DeductionThe increased computation power that improved our cryptanalysis so far threatens to create nearly unbreakable ciphers in the future. To stay ahead, we must be prepared to work more aggressively on gaining inside information on the technology.
Basic FortificationBy using stronger materials and metal reinforcements within the structures, we can construct larger fortifications without having to worry about them collapsing.
Upgrades Maximum land fort level: +1 Maximum coastal fort level: +1 Unlocks Stronghold Network
Improved Land FortsBy making better use of the land surrounding our fortifications, and incorporating new technology to boot, we can strengthen our existing structures and expand them even further.
Upgrades Maximum land fort level: +1 Enables Bunker Emplacement land cruiser module

Advanced Land FortsBy learning from past mistakes and reinforcing not only the structure itself, but also its base foundations, we will be able to construct much larger fortifications, that will be able to hold off even the most seasoned enemies.

Improved Coastal FortificationsBy making better use of the land surrounding our coastal fortifications, and incorporating new technology to boot, we can strengthen our existing structures and expand them even further.

Advanced Coastal FortificationsBy building our bunkers and fortifications further into the cliff-sides and hills, we can construct even larger complexes that have the ability to repel even the greatest of naval invasion forces.

This tree is heavily intertwined with various Aerodynamics and Avionics special projects related to rockets and rocketry. Experimental rockets is also sometimes referred to as ⟦0⟧.

Enables Rocket Site with a limit of 3 per state Unlocks Flying Bomb Ballistic Missile Rocket Interceptor
